title: Firefighters from 19 countries protest EU disaster budget cuts in Brussels
lede: Around 1,000 firefighters from 19 countries gathered in Brussels Tuesday to demand more equipment, more staff, and adequate healthcare, only weeks before key EU budget negotiations.
